name: wanapis-media
description: Generate images and video from inside Codex — Seedance, Veo, Kling, Midjourney, Seedream, Nano Banana and GPT-Image, through one WanAPIs key, with the cost shown before you run.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and video with cost estimates
interface.longDescription: Create images and video without leaving Codex. Every major model is reachable through a single WanAPIs key — Seedance, Veo, Kling, Midjourney, Seedream, Nano Banana and GPT-Image. You say low, medium or high; the plugin translates that into whatever each provider actually calls it. Because generation is billed per call, it estimates the cost from the live pricing feed before running, and reports what you were actually charged afterwards.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 5-second video of a paper plane gliding over a city at dusk
Make a product hero image of a ceramic mug on a linen backdrop
What would a 10-second 1080p clip cost on each video model?
